_comment: Example project asset manifest — single source of truth for custom scenery objects. Copy this dir as your project's FG_ASSETS_DIR and regenerate with tools/gen_objects.sh --json <this file>. Each object's scenery tile (.stg path) is COMPUTED from its lat/lon (tools/fg_tiles.py), so objects may span tiles. Location here is the classic FG demo area (KSFO) so the layer works out of the box with zero scenery downloads (ocean/generated terrain). elev_m is meters AMSL; kml_m is the ground-station marker square edge (0 = no marker). LESSON (proven live): flat ground QUADS placed via static .stg load but never RENDER — the ortho ground is drawn by the RUNTIME auto-place (nasal/addobj.nas + /ortho props); its entry here is only for bookkeeping + the .kml. Solid models (buoys, boxes) render fine from the .stg. The quad must sit just ABOVE local terrain and BELOW the landed camera — see readme.md render lessons.

objects.note: satellite ground quad (generated by gen_orthophotos); ACTUALLY drawn by the runtime /ortho auto-place, not this .stg line
